fields.System.Title: OUT-203 — FEFO allocation for expiry-tracked products
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a warehouse manager, I want the soonest-expiring stock allocated first, so that
dated stock is sold rather than written off.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given several batches of an expiry-tracked product, then the earliest expiry is
  • allocated first.
  • - Given a location holding two batches, then allocation targets the specific batch, not
  • just the location.
  • - Given an expired batch, then it is never allocated.
  • - Given an untracked product, then FIFO by receipt date applies instead.
  • - Given a reservation, then it records the specific batch so picking can verify it.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | outbound, inventory |
| Tables | allocation, reservation, batch |
| Risks | FEFO at location level ships the wrong batch ([doc 09 §4.1](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration |
